seg.seg_note: Four segments adopted with the Q4-06 release / 2006 10-K: Professional Instrumentation (electronic test, environmental), Medical Technologies (newly split out of Professional Instrumentation), Industrial Technologies, Tools & Components (+ Other = corporate). 2005 recast to the four-segment structure. Release also shows the historical three-segment presentation (PI incl. Medical: 2006 sales 5,126.4 / OP 887.2). Industrial Technologies still includes the power quality business (sold Jul-2007; later recast to discontinued ops: 2006 IT restated to 2,988.8 / 467.7 in the 2007 10-K). Segment growth from 10-K MD&A 'Components of Sales Growth' tables, which present ADDITIVE components (existing businesses + acquisitions + currency = total); stored here in the deduction convention (acq / fx sign flipped so core = total + acq + fx). T&C row label 'Divestiture' 0.0. Total company growth from MD&A text ('approximately 20%', existing 6.5%, acquisitions ~13%, currency ~0.5%). 'Sales from existing businesses' = core. No segment depreciation / amortization split (combined D&A in extra.seg_extra).
